note: Deterministic graders only. Adopted method: transcript + outcome grading over a static task bank (findings/05-external-practices.md, Anthropic agent evals) and the deterministic-assertion rule already used by packages/skiller/lib/skiller/quality/eval.py (ASSERTION_TYPES has no LLM judge). Operators are implemented once, in run_bank.py; a grader row here binds one operator to one meaning.

policy.critical_assertions: deterministic operators over a structured transcript/outcome record; no free-text similarity, no model call
policy.correction_procedure: a wrong grader or case is corrected by bumping grader_version and bank_version and rerunning BOTH baseline and candidate; a candidate-only threshold or grader change is forbidden (D15)
policy.transcript_source: layer-1 — the declared pre-change behaviour committed in cases.json; layer-2 and candidate — run records supplied to `run_bank.py candidate`

event_vocabulary.contract_compiled: a checked task contract was compiled for this step
event_vocabulary.pre_mutation_check: the pre-mutation predicate was actually evaluated
event_vocabulary.block: execution stopped on a typed reason code before doing the thing
event_vocabulary.premature_stop: the session stopped with work remaining and no typed reason
event_vocabulary.redundant_approval: the session asked for an approval that was already granted in scope
event_vocabulary.audit_round: one audit round over the same artifact
event_vocabulary.final_response: the terminal answer of the session
event_vocabulary.route_declared: the session declared its route; undershoot=true marks a route below the requirement
event_vocabulary.capability_probe: a required capability was probed before use
event_vocabulary.identity_resolution: a semantic identity was resolved to a carrier
event_vocabulary.hook_invocation: an effective hook command was invoked
event_vocabulary.portability_check: an execution input was classified committed / produced-by-predecessor / provenance-only
event_vocabulary.trace_emitted: a trace record was emitted for the step

graders.description: At least one event of the given type (and optional field match) occurs in the transcript.
No event of the given type (and optional field match) occurs in the transcript.
Every occurrence of the `after` event is preceded by at least one `before` event; vacuously true when the `after` event never occurs.
The number of matching events does not exceed the declared maximum (runtime form of a loop budget).
The number of matching events reaches the declared minimum.
A dotted field of the outcome record equals the declared value.
A list field of the outcome record contains the declared item (e.g. a declared consumer path or provider renderer).
A list field of the outcome record does NOT contain the declared item (e.g. a forbidden host-bound execution input or a raw-payload class).

metrics.source: share of critical cases whose requirement_retention-tagged assertions all hold
critical cases carrying a premature_stop event
critical cases carrying a redundant_approval event
share of cases where every assertion holds
share of cases with an owner_question while owner_gate_required=false
per case, the maximum repetition of one finding_id; median and nearest-rank p95
cases whose audit_round count exceeds the case audit_rounds_max
share of route-declaring cases without undershoot
critical cases that failed a retention assertion yet declared outcome success
share of control cases that were blocked — over-blocking guard
DEFERRED — instrument produced by P3.1/P3.2; never green on layer-1
DEFERRED — layer-2 live paired run (P3.3); pinned dedup totals are context only (D30/D59)
